sourceNotes.rawContent:
Product Description:
Radiate with sophistication wearing the Double Emerald-Cut CZ Silver-Plated Ring for Women. This dazzling ring features two large emerald-cut CZ stones, framed with brilliant halos for a luxurious finish. Designed to catch every eye, the Double Emerald-Cut CZ Silver-Plated Ring for Women is an instant showstopper, perfect for adding glamour and sparkle to your style, whether for everyday chic or a special event.
Why You Will Love It:
✨ Glamorous double emerald-cut centerpiece for maximum brilliance
✨ Sparkling halos amplify elegance and shine
✨ Comfortable adjustable fit for effortless wear
✨ Makes a stunning gift for birthdays, anniversaries, or celebrations
Highlights / Specifications:
🔹 Material: Premium high-quality alloy
🔹 Plating: Lustrous silver plating for a dazzling look
🔹 Stone Type: Emerald-cut cubic zirconia with halo accent stones
🔹 Design: Double twin rectangular solitaire for elegant statement
🔹 Size/Fit: Adjustable band fits most finger sizes
🔹 Best Use: Perfect for daily wear, party wear, or gifting
Care Instructions:
💎 Clean gently with a microfiber or polishing cloth
🚫 Avoid chemicals, water, and ultrasonic cleaners
🛑 Remove while swimming, showering, or gardening
🌡️ Store in a cool, dry place away from extreme temperatures
Perfect For:
🎁 Gifting on Weddings, Birthdays, Valentine's Day, Festivals
👭 Teen girls, daughters, sisters, and fashion-forward women
💃 Matching with western and ethnic outfits for a glam touch
